generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable. Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government Government of India Union Territory. Contractor should have independents PF Code.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee into the respective receiving bank accounts of eProcurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission. The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of eProcurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end. Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees as per e portal.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The tender is of two cover system. The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification. Rates shall be quoted in Tender Schedule B Financial Bid in the website itself.

For those tenderers whose Technical bids satisfy the eligibility criteria and who has furnished all the necessary documents, only their financial Bids will be opened. The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement. Conditional tenders will not be accepted

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/documents furnished by the tenderer should the circumstances so warrant. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect/false or invalid then the EMD furnished by such tenderer shall be forfeited

Right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons rests with the accepting authority. The successful bidders shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act. The contractor shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers working in this area.

The rates quoted by the Bidder shall be exclusive of GST but inclusive of all applicable taxes, levies, duties and cess, building welfare cess (if applicable) etc., as per latest GOK and Government of India prevailing as on the date of NIT. The Bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rates as issued by the PF Department from time to time. The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit (MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be charged as per the joint secretary, Energy Department letter no. Energy26 PPT 2022 dtd:26.04.2022 KPCL shall recover the Income tax etc., at the prevailing applicable rates.
Contractor should have independents PF Code. The Contractor shall remit PF of labourers to contractors permanent PF code Number only and Not to the KPCL PF Sub Code
If the contractor makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection

In case the agency fails to execute the work properly, engineer may entrust the work to the other agency at the cost and risk of original agency. The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the Last date of submission of bid.

Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the Office of the Executive Engineer (Civil), KPC Ltd. ,Shivasamudram, Malavalli Taluk, Mandya District 571430, during office hours. Mobile 918310609337.

Contract Performance Guarantee: The successful bidder has to furnish a e Bank Guarantee from a banks integrated by NeSL with KPPP towards Contract Performance Guarantee (CPG), for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract value plus additional performance security for unbalanced tender with an appropriate validity period (i.e. Validity period for CPG is the Contract period & maintenance period i.e., 18 Months. Validity period for Additional performance security is till completion of work) within 20 days from the date of issue of Work Order (WO) to the successful bidder. The e Bank Guarantee (eBG) shall be furnished. The total contract period is 22 Months (including monsoon period) The Security deposit for the tender shall be valid till contract period plus Additional performance security for unbalanced tender shall be valid till completion of work.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor at least one Civil work of value not less than Rs. 12.70 Lakhs in the preceding Five financial years (ie., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). The certificate issued by the Competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case of other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the Technical bid. (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27)

Any reputed individual/Company having valid KPWD contractor registration certificate of Class III & above are eligible for participation in the tender for which supporting documents shall be uploaded and are eligible for participation for which scanned copy of the same shall be uploaded

The Intending bidder in his name should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual Financial Turnover of value not less than Rs.25.40 Lakhs during the preceding five completed financial years (ie., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). The bidder shall submit the certified copy of Turnover certificate along with Profit & loss statement duly certified by the chartered Accountant along with UDIN for the respective two years & the same shall be uploaded along with the technical bid. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27).
